summary: Three changes. (1) pmdoc.ListMarks (pmdoc/find.go:793) walks with the positionless pmdoc.Walk instead of walk: measured 14-60 ms per call today on four real LINUX specs (a quarter to two thirds of a render), 0.15-0.69 ms after, identical list because Validate refuses children on the nodes walkNode skips. (2) pmdoc.yattrToMarkName (pmdoc/node.go:93) replaces its regexp with a byte check of the same semantics: pmdoc.Read 7-23 % faster, 16 % fewer allocations, fuzz-equal. (3) Two nil-outside-tests hooks in settleRoomWithin and a test (docs/settlement_read_invariant_test.go) that fails when read is changed anywhere but reconcileAskBlocks before a reused render; installed in INFRA-647's two render-once tests; two negative controls. readSettlementTree's copy, holdLive, recordedMarkRefs and the reuse condition are unchanged, with measured reasons in the plan.
tasks: 1. Code: pmdoc/find.go ListMarks -> Walk; pmdoc/node.go yattrToMarkName byte check, delete yattrMarkSuffix; reword the comment at pmdoc/marks.go:21; docs/service.go hooks afterSettleTreeRead (after readSettlementTree at :1485) and beforeSettleVersionRender (at the reuse decision :1661-1664).

2. Tests: pmdoc table test of yattrToMarkName edge cases with literal outputs; docs/settlement_read_invariant_test.go (goroutine-safe helper keyed by room, t.Errorf, settle=time.Hour, non-vacuous reuse count) also installed in TestSettlementVersionsARepairTheRoomAlreadyHolds and TestSettlementVersionsTheTreeOfAStampThatMintedNothing; negative controls (a) append a character to read's first text run after readSettlementTree, (b) changedTree() returns false; run pmdoc and docs packages on Postgres 17 + pgvector, dispatch/... and cmd/dispatch/..., go vet, -race -count=5 on settlement tests.

3. Throwaway equivalence on >=20 real LINUX specs, base vs head, deterministic (SetBlockIDGenerator counter, fixed ids, settle=time.Hour + settleCurrentGeneration, fixed s.now, UnrecordedMarkTTL small; unfixable ids/timestamps replaced by first-appearance order): reuse, sweep-after-TTL, stamp and repair settlements; dump versions, block rows, excerpts, token, ListMarks, unrecorded keys, read-tree hash; empty diff; negative control; -benchmem of ListMarks and Read base vs head.

4. Merge rule on the architect's replay (or INFRA-639's if merged): warmed dump, six alternating runs with tools/drive.sh <side>-<n> 0.3 1 27 8 at GOMAXPROCS=2; G = base ListMarks + yattrToMarkName under readSettlementTree; changed function share = sweepUnrecordedMarks + readSettlementTree cum; pass on (1) every head < every base or (2) share falls >= g/2, either when the other does not contradict (median(head) > max(base), or head share >= base share); the G<spread gate is not applied per dispatch://INFRA-512/comment/63dcf4bd; quote settleRoomWithin share, server-wide yattrToMarkName share, -lines -peek split, copy-path share, EXPLAIN of the recordedMarkRefs queries; else write-up on INFRA-512.

5. Docs: packages/envoy/AGENTS.md settlement paragraph names the tests that check the invariant; correct the 'No test enforces' bullet in docs/solutions/envoy/a-settlement-reuses-...-pr2416.md; changie new --kind Changed --custom Issue=pr<number>.
6. PR from legion/INFRA-648 with the Dispatch: INFRA-648 line only; ce-simplify-code once after the proof.
7. Production check after the merge: envoy-dispatch CPU and a live profile share, or pending deploy.
